basic_details.job_title: IIT Jodhpur Registrar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur (IIT Jodhpur), Rajasthan, has invited applications for the post of Registrar under Advt No. IITJ/OR(NF)/2026-27/65. The online application is open from 5 October 2026 to 18 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Masters’ degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks plus required administrative/teaching experience
qualification.details: Qualification: Masters’ degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade 'B' in the UGC 7-point scale from a recognized University/Institute Experience: At least 15 years’ experience as Assistant Professor in AGP of Rs.7,000 / Academic Pay Level 11 and higher, or at least 8 years of service in the AGP of Rs.8,000 / Academic Pay Level 12 and higher (including Associate Professor), along with experience in educational administration OR Experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education comparable to that above OR At least 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or equivalent in Pay Level 12 or above Age limit: Maximum 57 years (as on 3 November 2026) | Other conditions: | Candidates must be citizen of India Persons serving in Government, Semi-Government or PSU must produce NOC and vigilance clearance before interview Appointment is initially for a period of 2 years which may be extended up to a maximum period of 5 years | Desirable: | Degree in Management or LLB Knowledge of computing system including ERP Having experience of working in Centrally Funded Technical Institutes Experience in digitalization and digital implementation of office processes

how_to_apply: Submit application online through the Institute website https://erponline.iitj.ac.in/CAREER/auth/careerOpening.htm.
Pay the non-refundable application fee online if applicable.
Take a printout of the successfully submitted online application form.
Send the printout along with self-attested copies of supporting documents through proper channel (if applicable) to IIT Jodhpur postal address.
Superscribe the envelope with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF REGISTRAR (ON TENURE/DEPUTATION/BOTH)”.
important_instructions: Crucial date for determining eligibility criteria remains 03.11.2026 despite deadline extension No request for corrections in application form shall be entertained

content_sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. IITJ/OR(NF)/2026-27/65 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT Jodhpur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Masters’ degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade 'B' in the UGC 7-point scale from a recognized University/Institute Experience: At least 15 years’ experience as Assistant Professor in AGP of Rs.7,000 / Academic Pay Level 11 and higher, or at least 8 years of service in the AGP of Rs.8,000 / Academic Pay Level 12 and higher (including Associate Professor), along with experience in educational administration OR Experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education comparable to that above OR At least 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or equivalent in Pay Level 12 or above Age limit: Maximum 57 years (as on 3 November 2026) Other conditions: Candidates must be citizen of India Persons serving in Government, Semi-Government or PSU must produce NOC and vigilance clearance before interview Appointment is initially for a period of 2 years which may be extended up to a maximum period of 5 years Desirable: Degree in Management or LLB Knowledge of computing system including ERP Having experience of working in Centrally Funded Technical Institutes Experience in digitalization and digital implementation of office processes

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with incomplete application forms without relevant certificates will be summarily rejected Appointment letters, pay slips, unsigned experience certificates, self-employment certificates or PPO shall not be considered as valid proof of experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is on Tenure or Deputation basis initially for 2 years, extendable up to a maximum of 5 years

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificates of educational qualifications in chronological order including mark sheets Certificate of Date of Birth Valid Category certificate Certificates of experience in chronological order on official organization letterhead NOC and Cadre Clearance from Parent Organization (if applicable) Vigilance Clearance Certificate (if applicable) APAR/CR dossiers for the last 5 years (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit application online through the Institute website https://erponline.iitj.ac.in/CAREER/auth/careerOpening.htm. Pay the non-refundable application fee online if applicable. Take a printout of the successfully submitted online application form. Send the printout along with self-attested copies of supporting documents through proper channel (if applicable) to IIT Jodhpur postal address. Superscribe the envelope with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF REGISTRAR (ON TENURE/DEPUTATION/BOTH)”. Apply on or before 18 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date for determining eligibility criteria remains 03.11.2026 despite deadline extension No request for corrections in application form shall be entertained

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026. Applications opened on 5 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Registrar.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/Unreserved: Rs. 1,000. SC, ST, PwBD, EWS, Women, Ex-Serviceman, and Internal candidates: Nil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 57 years (as on 3 November 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level 14 (as per 7th CPC).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters’ degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks plus required administrative/teaching experience.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be citizen of India. Persons serving in Government, Semi-Government or PSU must produce NOC and vigilance clearance before interview. Appointment is initially for a period of 2 years which may be extended up to a maximum period of 5 years.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with incomplete application forms without relevant certificates will be summarily rejected. Appointment letters, pay slips, unsigned experience certificates, self-employment certificates or PPO shall not be considered as valid proof of experience.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on online applications and uploaded documents. Written Test(s), Skill/Trade Test and/or Presentation/Interview.
